title: Check: Comparing Aerobic and Anaerobic Respiration (D)

questions.stem: Why is aerobic respiration described as more efficient than anaerobic respiration?

options.text: It completely breaks down glucose, releasing more energy per molecule

questions.explanation: Aerobic respiration completely breaks down glucose into carbon dioxide and water, releasing all the stored energy. Anaerobic respiration only partially breaks down glucose, leaving energy trapped in lactic acid or ethanol.
